body.x: L4BOX (CEO Jang Hyunwoo) will participate in CES 2025, scheduled from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas, to exhibit at the K-Startup Pavilion.

Originally launched as an internal venture of LG Display, L4BOX has since established itself as an independent company. It aims to redefine children’s learning and play environments by digitizing traditional analog learning tools. By offering an interactive and social learning platform that bridges parents and children, L4BOX is aiming to redefine children's learning and play environments.

Its flagship product, ‘TokTokBox,’ is a 55-inch smart learning device designed for diverse applications in educational institutions, recreational facilities, and other environments. The platform includes customizable digital content and services, positioning itself as a unique player in the digital education market.
At CES 2025, L4BOX plans to further its global expansion by showcasing TokTokBox and leveraging the event to build international networks and identify new market opportunities.

The device integrates a 55-inch display with a camera to enable interactive engagement with its digital content. This technology encourages active participation and immersive learning experiences for users.

body.cap: 55-inch display and camera-based digital education platform 'TokTokBox' in use. | Photo provided by L4BOX

body.x: TokTokBox emphasizes the fusion of education and play, offering various content to stimulate creativity. Tailored to its users’ developmental stages, it supports social learning activities that foster communication and collaboration among multiple participants.

Notably, TokTokBox has proven effective in special education settings, including for children with developmental disabilities. Its interactive approach enhances focus, engagement, and overall educational outcomes, earning recognition in classrooms and therapy environments.

Domestically, TokTokBox has been adopted in hotels and resorts, transforming recreational spaces into engaging, family-friendly areas. The platform has been installed at the Saint John’s Hotel in Gangneung and Resom Resorts, demonstrating its versatility beyond traditional educational settings.
The company recently gained international attention at the Vietnam Education Expo, where it was honored with the ‘Best Newcomer Award,’ validating the global demand for its solutions.

L4BOX stated, “Participating in CES 2025 is a significant step towards expanding our presence in global markets. We aim to target key regions, particularly the highly active EdTech market in the U.S. and the rapidly growing sector in Vietnam. We will focus on finding partners to support these regions’ local distribution and maintenance services.”
